invariants.rationale: A non-null instantTime is likely required to uniquely identify the commit operation and avoid downstream NullPointerExceptions.
A valid partitionPath is necessary to locate the partition for this bulk commit.
The records collection should be non-null so that records can be committed.
A non-null MetadataTableFileGroupIndexParser is likely required for bulk commit indexing behavior.
The instantTime should not be empty to represent a valid commit moment.
